review_mode: Static frozen-source and recorded-evidence inspection; no independent test-suite rerun and no candidate/runtime source modifications. Pure-function regression probes executed from frozen AST definitions only.

recorded_checks.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_run_store.py tests/test_agent.py tests/test_execution_contracts.py tests/test_mcp_server.py
uv run ruff check jev_ultrafast/run_store.py jev_ultrafast/store_io.py jev_ultrafast/agent.py jev_ultrafast/mcp_server.py tests/test_run_store.py

resolved_findings.resolution: report_outcome handles PublicationUncertain separately, says the label may already be recorded and asks for storage inspection before retry. The post-rename fsync failure test confirms one outcome and no automatic review trigger.
Canonical JSON uses ASCII escapes with strict UTF-8 bytes, preserving lone surrogate browser strings and ordinary non-ASCII text on JSON roundtrip.
validate_run checks the by field is a string before set membership; malformed list/dictionary by values take the ordinary InvalidRun refusal and never replace bytes.

verified_properties: Execution saves and outcome appenders resolve the parent path, acquire the same .metadata.lock, read current bytes while locked, validate, and publish through a unique same-directory temporary.
Execution saves preserve the complete disk outcome array; reporter appends preserve executor fields. Legacy absent outcomes become an empty list; valid custom outcome fields survive.
Malformed JSON, outer object, outcome array or entries stop before replacement.
Threaded 25-reporter/25-executor test checks every label survives; alias-parent lock test checks shared lock identity.
The lock-owning call returns before lesson and review callbacks; a nonblocking lock assertion tests both callbacks.
Publisher flushes and fsyncs the temporary, performs replace/exclusive link, then fsyncs the parent. Post-publication OSError becomes PublicationUncertain.
Agent.save delegates to the shared store while retaining existing incomplete-run error handling.
limitations: Recorded focused suite: 338 passed and Ruff clean; independently inspected, not rerun.
Concurrent writer evidence uses actual thread publishers; no production process or real storage was touched.
Review receipt recovery, exact acknowledgments, process dispatch and shared publication recovery still require the subsequent REVIEWS checkpoint.
This prerequisite verdict does not authorize activation or migration.
